Population aged 65 and over in OECD members, 2025: 19.0%

# Population aged 65 and over in OECD members

19.0% of the population of OECD member countries was aged 65 or over in 2025. The value for 2025 is the highest in the series, which starts in 1960.

OECD members is a group: OECD member countries as grouped by the World Bank. The value is the aggregate published by World Bank, not an average calculated on this site.

 OECD members, 2025 19.0% % of total population Change from 2024 +0.4 percentage points 2024: 18.6% World, 2025 10.4% Official aggregate

## In short

- That is a change of +0.4 percentage points from 18.6% in 2024.
- Since 2015, when it was 15.8%, the figure has changed by +3.2 percentage points.
- The figure for the world in 2025 was 10.4%.
